title: The shop itself
logline: The frame shop's storefront in 2024, the last page of the sequence: a nail salon now, the same door, the same transom, and in the window's reflection the street and a man from behind with a small dog, looking at it. Twenty-nine years.

panels.composition: A storefront with a nail salon's sign, the same old door and transom as a frame shop, and in the window's reflection the street and a man in plaid from behind with a small three-legged dog, looking at it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small-town storefront now a nail salon with an old door and transom, its window reflecting the street and a man in plaid flannel seen from behind with a small three-legged dog looking at it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A nail salon. The transom the same.
